raw_response:
This plot is very small, and I do not want to spend cash on fertilizer for beans when I can use that money for food and other needs. I will plant my own local seed, put some manure if I have enough from home, and work it with my family because that is how I have managed such a plot before. I do not spray and I do not irrigate here; I wait for the rains and do what I have seen working on other small plots nearby.
